mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the past month (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 2.0%, it predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises and industrial production (INDPRO) falls, it predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.1pp and INDPRO falls > 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) decline, it predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls > 0.5% and RSAFS falls > 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.0%, it predicts negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) over the past month predicts negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rose over the past month (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).
